Qz.bar_b_note: The blown-out yellow orb bloom and tiny outcome text over an empty, uniform grass carpet with persistent party/action cards sink it; no groves, flowers or depth layering as in the Palworld field shots.

Dn.bar_b_note: Bright sky and pale dunes carry the Tidewake palette, but evenly scattered identical rocks, a ghost-translucent companion overlapping the target and empty sand slopes read as a prototype, not a shipped world.

Xx.bar_b_note: The ram matches the owner Stormcapra bar in fleece, horns and scale, but on a flat grey stage with flat lighting it lacks rim light and atmosphere, and B's faint mid/end mesh splays into flattened black-and-white patches.

Dc.bar_b_note: Strike and absorbing frames are tight top-down shots of a bloomed orb on bare grass with only a cropped companion edge, so neither the place nor the player-target relationship reads at a shipping finish.

Za.bar_b_note: The elder's white hair, beard and green-brown vest and scarf are appealing and on-palette, but the soft big-eyed cartoon face leans further from stylised realism than the key art, and it is shown only on a black backdrop.

Sr.bar_b_note: The distant landmark hill and blue sky help, but the uniform grass carpet with no groves or path and a reticle sitting on the target (plus A's white smoke trail in catch_high) keep it short of Palworld field density and readability.

Kv.bar_b_note: The armoured boar has a strong tusked silhouette and good scale against the ruler, but flat stage lighting, A's faint end collapsing to a near-black silhouette and B's pinkish-red tusks keep it below the owner bar finish.

Hh.bar_b_note: Very dark brown frames with no visible purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ring/slab telegraphs, heavy HUD on three sides and (in A i13/i15/i11) the camera buried in canopy sink it against the Palworld forest boss shot.

top_changes.change: Catch UI pass: hide persistent creature cards and action bars during catch result, tone down the orb bloom, show one large outcome banner on a deep blue-grey plate, and keep capture chance on a dark plate offset from the target and reticle; keep a wide camera that holds trainer, companion and target during strike/absorb.

Stormwood fight readability: keep the camera out of trunks and canopy, lift exposure with the purple storm sky and white-violet lightning rim light, slim the HUD, and replace the flat magenta telegraph rings/slabs with real ground-crack, dust or lightning tells with an impact.

Break the uniform grass carpet in Meadows catch scenes (Qz/Dc/Sr) with oak groves, wildflower patches, paths and rocks for foreground/midground/distance separation, and fix faint-pose material/mesh failures (Xx B splayed mesh, Kv A black faint end).
